description: Search the feed index by text and filters: format, audio/video, community, namespace and year of the newest item. Find feeds by text, format, language and availability. Filter and text search run in the SAME full-text query: values inside one parameter are OR'd, different parameters are AND'd. Without `q` the order is by newest in the index (`recentes`) and `next_cursor` is a keyset — follow `next` to walk everything. With `q` the order is relevance and paging is by `offset`. We index and link; the feeds belong to whoever publishes them.
